notta-pricing.0: Notta pricing is mostly about minutes. Every plan hands you a monthly pool of transcription time, then caps how long each recording can run and how many AI summaries you get. Know those 3 numbers. They tell you which plan fits.
notta-pricing.1: Below: what every tier costs, what its limits mean in real meetings, and how Notta stacks up against other transcription and meeting tools.
notta-pricing.2: Notta costs $0 on Free, $8.17 a month on Pro billed yearly, $16.67 per seat a month on Business billed yearly, and a custom price on Enterprise. Paying month to month? Then Pro runs about $13.99 and Business about $27.99 per seat.
notta-pricing.3: Yearly billing saves roughly 40% on Pro. Planning to keep it past 6 months? Then annual is cheaper.
notta-pricing.4: Yes, Notta has a free plan with 120 transcription minutes a month and no credit card, but each conversation is capped at 3 minutes. Leftover minutes do not roll over.
notta-pricing.5: On top of that, Free includes:
notta-pricing.6: That 3-minute cap turns Free into a demo rather than a meeting tool. Fine for short voice notes. Not for a 30-minute call.
notta-pricing.7: Notta Pro at $8.17 a month billed yearly gives 1,800 minutes a month, recordings up to 5 hours, 100 file uploads and 100 AI summaries monthly, plus transcript export, transcript translation and custom vocabulary.
notta-pricing.8: In practice, 1,800 minutes looks like this:
notta-pricing.9: Usually enough, then, for one person with a normal meeting load.
notta-pricing.10: Notta Business at $16.67 per seat a month billed yearly removes the minute cap and adds team features: web meeting video recording, advanced data security controls, a usage report, and CRM and Zapier integration. Per seat, you also get 200 file uploads and 200 AI summaries a month.
notta-pricing.11: Who is it for? Teams that record most of their meetings or need video. Enterprise starts at 51 seats and layers on SAML SSO, full data access control, audit logs, flexible payments and priority support.
notta-pricing.12: A 10-person team pays $1,999.90 a year on Notta Business billed yearly, or about $3,359 if it pays month to month. That gap adds up. Here is how Notta pricing scales across team sizes.
notta-pricing.13: Pro is priced per user, 1 seat each. Shared workspaces and usage reports? Those need Business.
notta-pricing.14: Yes, Notta sells some features as add-ons. According to a third-party pricing review, real-time translation and bilingual transcription start from $6 a month. Bigger hidden cost: the AI summary cap, which sits at 10 on Free, 100 on Pro and 200 on Business each month.
notta-pricing.15: Summarize every meeting? Count them. At 3 meetings a day, a user hits about 60 summaries a month, which fits Pro, while a heavy user transcribing many files can reach the 100-summary cap before running out of minutes.
notta-pricing.16: Most people should choose Pro: 1,800 minutes a month covers about 30 one-hour meetings for $8.17 billed yearly. Free is only for testing accuracy. Business fits a team that records most meetings or needs video, and Enterprise makes sense once IT demands SSO and audit logs.
notta-pricing.17: Before buying, run 2 real meetings through the free plan's uploads and check accuracy on your own accents and microphones. Keep excerpts short. That 3-minute cap applies to conversations.
notta-pricing.18: Notta's plans renew automatically. Downgrade before the renewal date if the free tier is all you need, but export any transcripts worth keeping first, because free-plan limits kick in the moment your paid period ends.
notta-pricing.19: Refund terms and cancellation steps can differ between annual and monthly billing. Check Notta's help center for the current version.
notta-pricing.20: At $8.17 billed yearly, Notta Pro is one of the cheapest paid meeting tools, close to Otter Pro at $8.33 and Tactiq Pro at $8. Its free plan, though, is the most restrictive of the bunch. A 3-minute cap per conversation.
notta-pricing.21: Sources: [Otter](https://otter.ai/pricing), [Tactiq](https://tactiq.io/pricing) and [Fathom](https://www.fathom.ai/pricing) pricing pages, checked 17 October 2026. Want a browser-based comparison? See [Tactiq alternatives](https://lynkk.ai/blog/tactiq-alternative).
notta-pricing.22: Notta is worth paying for if you need cheap transcription minutes, file uploads and translation. Less so if you want the meeting work done for you, meaning prep before calls plus tasks with owners and tickets after them.
notta-pricing.23: That gap is where Lynkk (our product) fits. Online meetings get recorded by a bot on Zoom, Google Meet and Teams; in-person or bot-free ones go through the Mac app and Chrome extension. Before each call there is a Meeting Brief, during it Cue answers (Pro), and afterwards come tasks with owners and dates, a decision log and one-click Jira tickets. Ask Lynkk searches all your meetings and cites the source.
notta-pricing.24: On language support, Lynkk covers 17 languages including Hindi and Hinglish. Free recordings run up to 2 hours, against 3 minutes on Notta Free. Pro is $15 a month. For more options, see our [Otter.ai alternatives](https://lynkk.ai/blog/otter-ai-alternatives) roundup.
notta-pricing.26: Notta Pro costs $8.17 a month billed yearly or about $13.99 on monthly billing, while Business costs $16.67 per seat a month billed yearly or about $27.99 monthly. Annual saves about 40% on Pro. Staying past 6 months? Then the annual plan is cheaper.
notta-pricing.27: Yes. Notta's free plan includes 120 transcription minutes and 10 AI summaries a month, but each conversation is capped at 3 minutes. That 3-minute cap turns the free plan into a demo. Good for testing accuracy on short clips, but not for real meetings.
notta-pricing.28: Notta Pro costs $97.99 a year on annual billing, which works out to $8.17 a month. For that you get 1,800 transcription minutes monthly, recordings up to 5 hours and 100 AI summaries a month. That summary allowance covers about 3 meetings every working day.
notta-pricing.29: Pro gives 1 user 1,800 minutes a month. Business offers unlimited transcription per seat and adds video recording, security controls, usage reports, and CRM and Zapier integration, which suits teams that record most meetings or need video. Above that, Enterprise starts at 51 seats with SSO and audit logs.
notta-pricing.30: Barely, on annual billing: Notta Pro is $8.17 a month and Otter Pro is $8.33. Otter's free plan is more usable, though, at 30 minutes per conversation versus Notta's 3. For comparison, Lynkk Free allows 2-hour recordings, and its $15-a-month Pro plan adds prep before calls and Jira tickets after them.
notta-pricing.31: No lifetime plan is listed. As of October 2026, Notta's pricing page shows only Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise, with monthly prices of about $13.99 for Pro and $27.99 per seat for Business. Promotions change, so check that page at checkout.
